Hi @{author}, thanks for the pull request.

We ask that first-time authors are vouched for by a maintainer before we review
their code, and you're not on our list yet, so this PR has been closed. Your
branch and your work are untouched.

To get vouched, open an issue saying hello and what you want to work on:

https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/issues/new?template=introduce-yourself.md

A maintainer will reply, usually within a day or two. **Once you've been
vouched**, reopen this PR and the check will pass. Reopening before then will
just close it again.

Why we do this:
https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{default_branch}/CONTRIBUTING.md#getting-vouched
